name: PyTorch & Scikit-learn
metaTitle: PyTorch and Scikit-learn Machine Learning Development
description: Techlio develops and deploys custom machine learning models for forecasting, classification, anomaly detection, and computer vision backed by reproducible training pipelines.
h1: Custom machine learning models, *from training to production.*
answer: PyTorch and Scikit-learn are the standard Python libraries for building machine learning models: PyTorch for deep learning and computer vision, Scikit-learn for classical prediction and classification. Techlio uses them to build custom models when a general language model is not the right tool, with reproducible training, held-out evaluation and monitored serving.

builds.title: Forecasting and scoring
builds.text: Models trained on your data for demand forecasting, lead and risk scoring, and routing.

builds.title: Computer vision
builds.text: Models that analyse images and video, served through an application people can use.

builds.title: Anomaly detection
builds.text: Detection of unusual transactions, readings or behaviour, with thresholds your team controls.

fits: You have historical data and a decision that is made repeatedly
A general language model alone does not solve the problem
You need the model running in production, not only in a notebook

faqs.question: Do we need a custom model?
faqs.answer: Often not. A current language model with good retrieval solves many problems. We recommend custom training only when it clearly performs better or costs less.

faqs.question: How do you know the model is good?
faqs.answer: Against a held-out test set and agreed metrics before launch, and by monitoring in production afterwards.
